title: Assassin Seek
description: AssassinSeek is a real hide-AND-seek multiplayer stealth game where every player is an assassin disguised as a villager. There are no innocents, not hide-or-seek — only hunters pretending to be sheep. Blend into a living crowd of NPCs. Watch for the one who hesitates, turns too sharply, or doesn’t walk like the rest. Then close in for a silent kill… or risk a bowshot that could expose you to everyone nearby.Daylight makes mistakes costly. Night hides you — and everyone else. Survive by reading the crowd, managing your outfit, and never looking like the killer.Key Gameplay FeaturesHide in plain sight — Share the same look as a crowd of villagers; win by reading behavior, not nameplatesBlade or bow — Instant melee assassinations and deadly ranged shots when you need distanceDay / night risk — Killing villagers by day can strip your disguise; night covers your tracksMultiple game modes — Each with different challengeOutfit systems — Re-dress mid-match blending into a living crowd of NPCs, which could also expose yourself if you don't dress properlyMultiple profession — Each with different abilitiesMultiple win modes — Race to a kill quota, survive as last standing, or fight on a timed clockMultiplayerSteam multiplayer — Create or join lobbies with friends and jump straight into a matchGame streamers friendly — Can easily host private or viewer participation gamesYou have many friends — Great! there no player limit, the game is built for many player, but I don't have that many friends to test itYou need more friends — Great! join/host a public lobbyThe maximum number of players depends on the host's network/PC environment. (With great power comes great responsibility)Every face in the crowd could be prey — or your next assassin.
